user.title: Guest panel
user.description: A page at `/guest` for people visiting your home: no account, no app. It only answers devices connected to the networks you list.

data_description.networks: Your Wi-Fi network in CIDR format, for example 192.168.1.0/24. You can add several.
data_description.entities: When «A list of entities» is chosen. Sensors are shown read-only.
data_description.link_hours: Hours each link or QR code works for. Once it expires, the guest has to scan a new code. Codes are created under «Guest QR» in the sidebar. With 0 no link is required: anyone on the allowed networks gets in, even with an old QR code.
data_description.source: A list of entities, or every entity on a dashboard you build for guests.
data_description.dashboard: When «A dashboard» is chosen. Guests see its entities with its cards' titles, order, names and icons, and can only use those. When you change the dashboard, the panel follows.

error.invalid_network: One of the networks is not valid. Use the format 192.168.1.0/24.
error.dashboard_empty: That dashboard has no cards with entities. The auto-generated «Overview» dashboard does not count until you edit it; better create one for guests.

panel.title: Guest panel
panel.description: A page at `/guest` for people visiting your home: no account, no app. It only answers devices connected to the networks you list.

data_description.networks: Your Wi-Fi network in CIDR format, for example 192.168.1.0/24. You can add several.
data_description.entities: When «A list of entities» is chosen. Sensors are shown read-only.
data_description.link_hours: Hours each link or QR code works for. Once it expires, the guest has to scan a new code. Codes are created under «Guest QR» in the sidebar. With 0 no link is required: anyone on the allowed networks gets in, even with an old QR code.
data_description.source: A list of entities, or every entity on a dashboard you build for guests.
data_description.dashboard: When «A dashboard» is chosen. Guests see its entities with its cards' titles, order, names and icons, and can only use those. When you change the dashboard, the panel follows.

add_user.title: Restrict a user
add_user.description: Pick a Home Assistant user who is not an administrator. They will stop seeing and controlling everything you do not allow in the next step.

user_settings.title: Permissions for {name}

data.condition_entity: Entity that shows they are home

data_description.always_entities: They can see and control these from anywhere.
data_description.family_location: Always allows the map (people and zones) and the Family Location entities, including the check-in and ask-for-help buttons.
data_description.home_entities: They can see and control these only while the condition below is met.
data_description.condition_entity: Usually the Wi-Fi connection sensor of their phone (Home Assistant app). A device_tracker from your router also works.
data_description.away_read: If off, these entities do not appear to them while away.

user_settings.description: In the next step you say which state of the entity means «home».

remove_user.title: Stop restricting
remove_user.description: The users you pick get the normal access of a Home Assistant user back.

revoke_links.title: Revoke guest links
revoke_links.description: Every link and QR code handed out so far stops working immediately. Guests will have to scan a new code.

appearance.title: Guest panel appearance
appearance.description: Entity names and icons are the ones you already have in Home Assistant. Here you choose the theme, the colours and, if you want, the order and sections.

data_description.theme: Any theme installed in your Home Assistant.
data_description.accent: Optional, as #rrggbb. Replaces the theme's primary colour.
data_description.welcome: Optional. Shown under the title; for example the house rules.
data_description.layout: Optional. A list of sections with a title and entities, as in an entities card. Each entity can have its own name, icon (one, or one per state), states (the text shown for each state) and buttons (the text of each button). Leave it empty to group by area. If the panel uses a dashboard, the dashboard is the layout and this field is not used.
data_description.background: Optional, for example /local/background.jpg (a file in Home Assistant's www folder). If empty, the chosen dashboard's or the theme's background is used. With an image, cards look translucent.

home_state.title: When are they home?
home_state.description:
Right now **{entity}** reports: **{state}**

If that phone is connected to your Wi-Fi at this moment, that is the value to use. It must match exactly; if it does not, the person will never get their «home» access.

data_description.condition_states: Your Wi-Fi name (SSID), exactly as the sensor shows it. For a device_tracker, type home.

safety.title: Safety and notifications
safety.description: When the guest panel works, and who hears about what guests do. You can also pause it at any time with the «Guest panel» switch, from your dashboards or automations.

data.require_home: Only while someone from the household is home

data_description.require_home: The panel stops working when no person of the household is «home». Restricted users (such as a relative who shares their location) do not count.
data_description.condition_states: For example disarmed for an alarm that is off.
data_description.notify_on: Everything is also recorded in Home Assistant's logbook and as an ha_guest_event event.

error.invalid_network: One of the networks is not valid. Use the format 192.168.1.0/24.
error.invalid_color: Use a colour in #rrggbb format, for example #ff9800.
error.invalid_layout: The layout is not valid. It must be a list of sections, each with «entities».
error.layout_not_allowed: The layout uses entities that are not on the guest panel's list: {entity}
error.dashboard_empty: That dashboard has no cards with entities. The auto-generated «Overview» dashboard does not count until you edit it; better create one for guests.
error.invalid_background: Use a Home Assistant address such as /local/background.jpg, or one starting with https://.

abort.no_users: There are no users to restrict. First create a non-administrator user in Settings → People.

options.blocked: Someone with an expired link, or while the panel is paused, tries to get in
